entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It doesn't work.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a technical fault. This thing is a piece of garbage. The heart rate reading is completely wrong. I want a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the heart rate tracking. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can help you with that. I just need to pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, order 774-B-91. Look, I don't need help. I just want to send it back.

Thank you, Sam. I have your order here. I see you received the VeloBand 12 days ago. For a defect claim like this, our first step is to attempt some basic troubleshooting. It often resolves the issue right away.
No! I told you, I don't have time for that! I already tried restarting it. It's broken. Just give me my money back.

I understand your frustration, Sam. However, our policy for the VeloBand Pulse is a bit different from our other products. Because it's a health device that syncs personal data, it has a strict 10-day return window for a full refund. Since we're on day 12, we've moved into the warranty and technical support phase.
Are you kidding me? Ten days? That's insane! You people just want money and sell faulty products you know will fail after a week.

I can assure you that's not the case. We stand by our products, which is why we have a robust warranty. To process a claim under that warranty, we first need to verify the defect. Without troubleshooting, I can't confirm the fault, and without that confirmation, I can't authorize a return outside the 10-day window. I must follow the policy.
This is absolute garbage service! I don't want a replacement, I want a refund! Let me speak to your manager right now! I'm going to post about this everywhere.

I can definitely transfer you to my supervisor. I do need to advise you that they will have to follow the same VeloFit policy regarding the 10-day return window for this specific device. Would you still like me to proceed with the transfer?
Unbelievable. Just forget it. You've been no help at all. You've just lost a customer for life.
I'm sorry we couldn't reach a different resolution for you today, Sam. If you reconsider troubleshooting, our technical support team is available 24/7. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Goodbye.
